# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::code_block`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The code block (`text.code-block`, D10): the read-only code view in a frame with a copy button.

The body is the [code editor](code_editor.md)'s frame, read-only, without a gutter and
scrolling only sideways, inside a faint box with a padding. Colours come from spans the app
passes by line (D45). The copy button sits in the top-right corner: it puts the whole text on
the clipboard and swaps its icon for a check mark for [`CodeBlockOptions::feedback_ms`](code_block.md#structfield.CodeBlockOptions.feedback_ms), with a
polite `Status` node while the mark shows.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/code_block.rs:1`

```rust
pub struct CodeBlockOptions<'a> {
    pub label: &'a str,
    pub spans: &'a [(usize, HighlightSpan)],
    pub size: f32,
    pub line: f32,
    pub pad: (f32, f32),
    pub border: bool,

}
```

What [`Ui::code_block`](../ui.md#method.Ui.code_block) and [`height`](code_block.md#fn.height) are given besides the text. The defaults are the compact
look; the roomy one is `size: 13.0, line: 20.0, pad: (12.0, 10.0), border: true`.

**Fields**

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.label"></a>`pub label: &'a str`

  The accessible name of the text.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.spans"></a>`pub spans: &'a [(usize, HighlightSpan)]`

  Highlight spans by line, 0-based, in chars of the line. Lines that do not exist are
  ignored, and so are empty and inverted spans; a span past the line's end is clamped.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.size"></a>`pub size: f32`

  The mono size.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.line"></a>`pub line: f32`

  The line height.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.pad"></a>`pub pad: (f32, f32)`

  The padding, horizontal then vertical.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.border"></a>`pub border: bool`

  A 1 px `border_subtle` ring round the box; the padding then starts inside it.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.feedback_ms"></a>`pub feedback_ms: u64`

  How long the check mark shows after a copy, in milliseconds of app time.

- <a id="structfield.CodeBlockOptions.tab_stop"></a>`pub tab_stop: bool`

  The text is a Tab stop. Off, a press still focuses it and Tab skips it.

## Functions

<a id="fn.height"></a>
### Function `height`

```rust
pub fn height(_ui: &Ui<'_>, text: &str, opts: &CodeBlockOptions<'_>) -> f32
```

The height of the block for `text`: its lines, the padding and the border. A host sizes the
rect with it. `ui` is taken so a later release can measure; today the lines are counted.
